contentText:
These are the top five moments from the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards, featuring Rosalía, Ozuna, Fuerza Regida, Peso Pluma, Tito Double P and Cristian Castro, who all delivered unforgettable highlights. Watch our Billboard Noticias countdown of the night’s biggest surprises and standout performances.

From Rosalía borrowing a viral Caso Cerrado phrase (“Here you speak Spanish”) to Ozuna’s high-energy medley, plus Fuerza Regida’s surprise reveal, Peso Pluma popping up onstage with Tito Double P, and Cristian Castro’s charismatic performance before receiving the Lifetime Achievement Award — these were the moments we can’t stop talking about.

Presented by McDonald’s. Monopoly is back at McDonald’s with lots of prizes, from cash, trips and vehicles. Plus, each play gives you a 1-in-5 chance to win free McDonald’s food. Peel and play on the McDonald’s app for a chance to win — so go get yours.

Jessica Roiz 

Sensational performances, superstar wins and outstanding moments. The Billboard Latin Music Awards really killed it this year with a totally phenomenal show. Before we recap the best moments of the night, we want to tell you how you can also win big. Monopoly is back at McDonald’s with lots of prizes, from cash, trips and vehicles. Plus, each play gives you one in five chances to win free food from McDonald’s. Peel and play on the McDonald’s app for a chance to win. So go get yours.

Now, back to the show. Here’s our selection of the top five moments of the night. Starting with this fun moment when the iconic Rosalía borrowed a viral phrase from the court show ‘Caso Cerrado’ to celebrate music in Spanish. Rosalía channeled the motto of Dr. Ana María Polo: “Here you speak Spanish.” And long live music in Spanish. No good afternoon or hello. The next moment came from an epic performance by Ozuna. The Puerto Rican star reminded everyone why he’s an OG of reggaeton with an energy-filled medley. Ozuna started inside a studio singing his most recent Billboard No. 1 “Una Aventura,” then moved to a big stage surrounded by dancers to the rhythm of “Sí, Sí.” Moving on to another memorable moment of the night was when the big winners Fuerza Regida took the stage accompanied by a dozen Chuyines. It was a great revelation at the end, when the masked characters took off their giant heads to reveal that the members of the band Fuerza Regida were underneath.
